frontmatter.name: writing-shape
frontmatter.description: Writing, exploit — shape raw material into an article, paragraph by paragraph.

frontmatter.name: writing-fragments
frontmatter.description: Writing, explore — mine raw fragments, no structure yet.

frontmatter.name: writing-beats
frontmatter.description: Writing, exploit — assemble raw material into a journey of beats, grounding each term before a beat leans on it.

frontmatter.name: wizard
frontmatter.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through a manual procedure — third-party setup, a one-off migration, an A→B state transition — opening URLs, capturing values, confirming each step, and writing .env files and GitHub Actions secrets.

frontmatter.name: wayfinder
frontmatter.description: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

frontmatter.name: upload-file
frontmatter.description: Upload a local file, screenshot, or piped output to the i.mia.cx R2 bucket and get back a public URL. Use when the user asks to upload, host, or share a file, wants a link to an image, screenshot, log, diff, or report, or when a result is easier to hand over as a URL than as inline text. Also covers listing and deleting previously uploaded objects, and configuring ShareX or ishare clients.

frontmatter.name: ui-design
frontmatter.description: Use when designing, building, reviewing, or refining product UI or marketing pages; choosing layout, color, typography, spacing, motion, or component structure; fixing generic or templated interfaces; or auditing UX, accessibility, or design consistency.

frontmatter.name: triage
frontmatter.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

frontmatter.name: to-questionnaire
frontmatter.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

frontmatter.name: teach
frontmatter.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
frontmatter.argument-hint: What would you like to learn about?

frontmatter.name: tdd
frontmatter.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

frontmatter.name: talk-normal
frontmatter.description: Shape every piece of output: chat responses, PR descriptions, docs, commit messages, GitHub comments, prose, copy. Must always apply.

frontmatter.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
frontmatter.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills — set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

frontmatter.name: say-more
frontmatter.description: Withhold reasoning by default; expand only when the user says "say more" or asks for an explanation. Must always apply: load at session start and keep loaded.

frontmatter.name: say-less
frontmatter.description: Say what you mean exactly once; stop when the request is satisfied. Must always apply: load at session start and keep loaded.

frontmatter.name: review-relay
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks for a review relay or review loop, for repeated or multi-provider review passes on a pull request, for a PR to be reviewed until it is clean or merge-ready, or to address review comments and resolve review discussions on a PR. A request for one review pass over a diff is not a relay.

frontmatter.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
frontmatter.description: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.

frontmatter.name: refine-skill
frontmatter.description: Audit and slim a SKILL.md: invocation mode, description, body, references.

frontmatter.name: refine-rule
frontmatter.description: Audit and slim always-loaded guidance: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules.

frontmatter.name: refine-plan
frontmatter.description: Audit and sharpen a plan, PRD, or handoff another agent will execute.

frontmatter.name: refine
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to refine, slim, or audit an agent-consumed document: a skill, a memory/rules file, or a plan.

frontmatter.name: prototype
frontmatter.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

frontmatter.name: prd-to-issues
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to break down a PRD into issues or create implementation tickets. Also use when writing a plan or roadmap based on a PRD to keep things traceable.

frontmatter.name: pr-merge
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to merge or land a pull request, or says "ship it" for an already-reviewed PR.

frontmatter.name: pr-file
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to file a pull request or put the current branch up for review.

frontmatter.name: next-slice
frontmatter.description: Advance to the next PRD slice after a merge: clean up the finished worktree and branch, fast-forward main, pick the next unblocked sub-issue of the PRD, set up a fresh worktree, and hand off to address-issue. Use when the user says "next slice", "move on", "advance", or wants to start the next issue after a merge.

frontmatter.name: loop-me
frontmatter.description: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.
frontmatter.argument-hint: A workflow to design, or nothing to go find one

frontmatter.name: improve-codebase-architecture
frontmatter.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

frontmatter.name: handoff
frontmatter.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
frontmatter.argument-hint: What will the next session be used for?

frontmatter.name: grilling
frontmatter.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

frontmatter.name: grill-with-docs
frontmatter.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

frontmatter.name: git-commit-and-push
frontmatter.description: Splits uncommitted changes into a small set of logical, single-concern git commits, then executes the commits and pushes to remote. Use when the user wants to commit and push, organize changes into logical commits, split a large change into multiple commits, or create a series of conventional commits from the current working tree.

frontmatter.name: gh-comment
frontmatter.description: Use when posting, editing, or replying to a comment on a GitHub pull request (a conversation comment, an inline comment on a diff line, or a reply in a review thread), including when another skill needs to publish results to a PR.

frontmatter.name: domain-modeling
frontmatter.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.

frontmatter.name: doc-coauthoring
frontmatter.description: Use when the user wants to write or co-author a doc — a proposal, technical spec, decision doc, or RFC.

frontmatter.name: diagnosing-bugs
frontmatter.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

frontmatter.name: create-prd
frontmatter.description: Use when the user wants to write a PRD or plan anything bigger than a single feature or slice — multi-feature efforts, new systems, epics, large refactors.

frontmatter.name: codex-subagents
frontmatter.description: Use when dispatching subagent work to GPT models (gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.5) via the Codex CLI, including inside Workflows.

frontmatter.name: codex-review
frontmatter.description: Get an independent code review from the Codex CLI (gpt-5.6-sol) — uncommitted changes, a branch diff, a commit, or a specific implementation.

frontmatter.name: codebase-design
frontmatter.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

frontmatter.name: codex-computer-use
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to test a flow, verify UI behavior, inspect a running app, or capture screenshots.

frontmatter.name: audit-dependencies
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to audit, check, or upgrade dependencies, or mentions vulnerabilities, outdated packages, or dependency bloat.

frontmatter.name: ask-matt
frontmatter.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

frontmatter.name: agent-copy
frontmatter.description: Use when writing text an agent will consume: a skill, rule or memory file, plan, or subagent prompt.

frontmatter.name: address-issue
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks to address or implement an issue.

frontmatter.name: momentum
frontmatter.description: Shape output for ADHD readers: lower the cost of starting and keep work visibly moving with a small first action, numbered steps, visible wins. Must always apply: load at session start and keep loaded.

frontmatter.name: research
frontmatter.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.
